Help

Vessel types

The available vessel types are decoded below:

  • cc: Catamaran-car ferry, power boat that carries passengers and vehicles
  • cf: Car-ferry, vessel that carries passengers and vehicles
  • cm: Catamaran, power boat of great capacity that carries solely passengers
  • hf: Hydrofoil, (Flying Dolphin), power boat of smaller capacity and of a different -than the catamaran- construction, that carries solely passengers
  • mv: Motor vessel: it carries solely passengers
  • rr:Car ferry RO-RO, that carries solely vehicles
  • ci: Caique, traditional wooden motor vessel that carries solely passengers
Help

Ferry schedule effectiveness

Displays the period during which the schedule is operative. Cases are:

  • If 'from' date only is displayed, this means that the particular schedule has been operative since the date mentioned and will continue to be operative until further notice.
  • If 'until' date only is displayed, this means that the particular schedule has already been operative and will continue to be so until the date mentioned.
  • If no date is displayed, this means that the particular schedule will be operated throughout the year until further notice.
